category.description: Known values: StatDelta, Behavior, Narrative, Habit, Recovery, FocusArea. New values may be added at any time; treat any other value as unknown.

sessionType.description: Known values: Range, Putting, ShortGame, Simulator, Lesson, Other. New values may be added at any time; treat any other value as unknown.

source.description: Known values: Manual, Import, Coach, Other. New values may be added at any time; treat any other value as unknown.
